title: Decoupled SEO verified locally; production remains unchanged
summary: Durable background synchronization passed deliberate SEO failures and commerce regression tests. Node 24 candidate build and dashboard browser checks passed. Production rollout requires separate approval.

changes.detail: Standalone SQL replacement, durable latest-state queue, separate scheduler worker, leases, atomic completion, exponential retries, failure recovery and read-only postflight.
Admin synchronization counts, heartbeat, stale/unavailable warnings and sanitized retry errors; scoped isolated candidate and rollout/environment/monitoring/recovery instructions.

Current-fact metadata fallback prevents stale stored content. Restored the root preorderEnabled mapping already present in the previous candidate after TypeScript exposed its absence. Corrected local concurrency harness address formatting; sandbox font/process limitations resolved for validation.

validation.name: Actual SQL and worker failure injection
validation.detail: PGlite tests passed backfill, updates, deletion, queue outage catch-up, retries through eight attempts, lease recovery, stale tokens, duplicate prevention, permanent metadata, approval conflicts, grants/RLS and migration rerun. Existing checkout/inventory/coupon/preorder suite passed with queue and generation deliberately broken.

validation.name: Multi-connection PostgreSQL 18.6
validation.detail: Synthetic localhost cluster: product creation and stock writes succeeded while SEO tables held exclusive locks; concurrent workers claimed distinct jobs, blocked reconciliation timed out, stale acknowledgement rejected. Cluster stopped. Production PostgreSQL 17 not tested.

validation.name: Application and history tests
validation.detail: 46 distinct focused application tests; 26 focused tests on isolated candidate; six history tests. Root and learning-app TypeScript passed. Focused ESLint passed. Candidate hashes verified; original migration hash preserved.

validation.name: Node 24 build and browser
validation.detail: Isolated Next.js 15.5.24 production build passed under Node 24.22.0 with placeholder credentials and reused dependencies. Existing unrelated lint/workspace warnings remain. Browser fixtures passed synchronization health/error states and editor/bulk/history at 375, 768 and 1440px; mobile screenshot inspected.

validation.name: Hosted acceptance and deployment
validation.detail: No production migration, data mutation, deployment or hosted scheduler activation. Real Supabase/PostgREST/Auth, payments, clean Linux installation and production load still require hosted validation and separate rollout approval. No preview link is claimed.
